highlights_headline: Backports the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM fix and a WinUI Projection DLL fix to 3.119.x.

bullets.detail: Brings the 26.0 library TFM and unversioned app TFM fix from the v4 line back to 3.119.x so Apple consumers on this line get the same target-framework alignment.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL missing for .NET 9 fixed
bullets.detail: Resolves a packaging issue where the WinUI projection DLL could not be found by .NET 9 consumers.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs to the 3.119.x line
